description: Trigger evals for devrites-prose-craft — the model-invoked specialist that humanizes DevRites artifacts and replies while preserving technical content.

queries.text: Humanize this prose without losing any technical content or identifiers.
queries.rationale: The defining humanize-with-fidelity branch should route directly here.

queries.text: Remove the AI-writing tells from this artifact, but preserve every fact and constraint.
queries.rationale: AI-writing tell removal is an explicit trigger branch.

queries.text: Match this paragraph to the supplied writing sample without inventing opinions or history.
queries.rationale: Writing-sample voice calibration belongs to prose craft.

queries.text: Edit this generated-sounding reply into natural prose while keeping the exact commands and errors.
queries.rationale: Reply humanization plus protected technical tokens is a named branch.

queries.text: Rewrite this commit prose in the project's existing voice and keep the decision record intact.
queries.rationale: Commit prose and project-voice matching are explicit branches.

queries.text: This PR prose reads like AI writing; humanize it without changing status codes or links.
queries.rationale: PR prose humanization with technical fidelity belongs here.

queries.text: Run the prose pass on these artifacts and remove chatbot phrasing without dropping evidence.
queries.rationale: The artifact prose-pass branch is explicit.

queries.text: Audit this prose for AI-writing tells in detect-only mode; do not rewrite the source.
queries.rationale: Detect-only prose auditing is part of the specialist contract.

queries.text: Calibrate this note to the neighboring project's voice, preserving its uncertainty and examples.
queries.rationale: Project-voice calibration with fidelity belongs to prose craft.

queries.text: Make this user-facing reply sound human, concise, and specific without adding new claims.
queries.rationale: Natural user-facing reply prose is a named trigger branch.

queries.text: Rename the generic variables and remove tutorial comments from this TypeScript file.
queries.rationale: Code anti-slop belongs to build/polish, not prose craft.

queries.text: Design a distinctive settings page with accessible loading and error states.
queries.rationale: Frontend craft owns UI implementation.

queries.text: Polish the dashboard layout and replace the generic card grid.
queries.rationale: Rite-polish and frontend craft own visual polish.

queries.text: Review the authentication diff for security vulnerabilities.
queries.rationale: Security review owns code findings.

queries.text: Debug why the API returns 500 for an empty request body.
queries.rationale: Debug recovery owns root-cause diagnosis.

queries.text: Run the test suite and record evidence for every acceptance criterion.
queries.rationale: Rite-prove owns verification.

queries.text: Refactor this handler to remove the unnecessary interface and factory.
queries.rationale: Code cleanup is not a prose task.

queries.text: Explain how this module works to a developer who is new to the repository.
queries.rationale: Rite-explain owns explanatory walkthroughs rather than artifact humanization.

queries.text: Generate API documentation from these route signatures.
queries.rationale: Documentation generation is not automatically a style rewrite.

queries.text: Update the changelog with the released fixes and version number.
queries.rationale: A factual changelog update does not require prose craft unless style editing is requested.
